subject: Error with modificationIndices (NAs are not allowed in subscripted assignments)

messages.author: 3ad2e3c8753ce3ec
messages.subject: Error with modificationIndices (NAs are not allowed in subscripted assignments)
parts:
Hi all,

I seem to be getting this error when trying to examine the modification indices:

library(lavaan)

adhd_home_env <- read.csv("adhd_home_env.csv")

mod_meas <- '
  ## latent variable definitions (CFA)
  # The "=~" can be read as "is identified by"
  HOME_t1 =~ accept_t1 + variety_t1 + acStim_t1
  HOME_t2 =~ accept_t2 + variety_t2 + acStim_t2
  
  ## covariances
  HOME_t1 ~~ HOME_t2 + adhd_t1 + adhd_t2
  HOME_t2 ~~ adhd_t1 + adhd_t2
  adhd_t1 ~~ adhd_t2
'

fit_meas <- cfa(mod_meas, data = adhd_home_env)

modificationIndices(fit_meas)
#> Error in tmp[cbind(REP$row[idx], REP$col[idx])] <- lavpartable$free[idx] : 
#>   NAs are not allowed in subscripted assignments

(I know the model fits poorly - that's the point of this this teaching exercise...)

Any help would be appreciated...
